title: The 1RB1LA counter pair halts exactly when its round map hits a corner (Coq)
text: For 1RB1LA_1LC1RD_1LA0LC_1RE0RB_1RB0RF_0RB--- and 1RB1LA_1LC1RD_1LA0LC_1RE0RB_1RB0RF_1RC---, Coq now proves that every corner of the closed counter model halts, for every size, so with the earlier half the machines halt if and only if the model orbit from (2, 5) reaches X = 2L (halts_iff_corner). A GMP port of the round map ran 400,000 rounds without a corner. A corner needs the unread top of X to equal, exactly, a number built from the bits a round read; no invariant excluding that is known.
